signed_assertion.description: Compact RS256 JWS; see the decide operation, PolicyReviewAssertionHeader and PolicyReviewAssertionClaims.

post.description: Records one immutable reviewer vote on the exact current revision; it never creates an action permit, reservation or operational authorization. Requires an authenticated human S01 principal with authorization.policy.review for the policy's exact service (not '*'). The reviewer must be listed in eligible_approver_ids and must differ from proposed_by. expected_revision must equal the current revision (409 REVISION_CONFLICT otherwise). Each reviewer may vote once per revision (409 DUPLICATE_VOTE); retries with the same Idempotency-Key and content replay the original vote. APPROVE requires signed_assertion: a compact JWS (RS256) whose header is PolicyReviewAssertionHeader and whose payload is the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of PolicyReviewAssertionClaims. The signature is verified with the public key selected by kid from the operator-provisioned versioned PolicyTrustSet, which must be scoped to the same tenant, environment, service and reviewer; unknown or removed keys are rejected (422 ASSERTION_KEY_UNTRUSTED). The claims bind tenant, environment, policy id and revision, service, policy digest, reviewer, decision and reason exactly. REJECT requires signed_assertion=null and the same reviewer authorization. Quorum is max(1, definition.required_approver_count) distinct eligible approving reviewers; votes below quorum leave the revision DRAFT, reaching quorum makes it APPROVED, and any rejection makes it REJECTED; both outcomes are final (409 DECISION_FINAL). For a decided revision, reviewer_id, review_reason, reviewed_at and assertion fields describe the decisive vote and review.votes lists every vote. current_eligible is true only when the revision is APPROVED, is the current revision, is inside its effective/expiry window, and at least quorum approvals still verify against keys present and unchanged in the current trust set (review.valid_approval_count). A configured trust revision lower than one already recorded, or different content under a recorded revision, fails closed with 503.
